Japan Man Jailed for Exploiting 12-Year-Old Thai Girl

Masayuki Hosono, a former operator of a massage parlor in Tokyo, has been sentenced to five years in prison. He was found guilty of employing a 12-year-old Thai girl and forcing her to perform sexual services. The court convicted him of these charges.
